jobs.employer_name: Deutsches Institut für Ernährungsforschung Stiftung des öffentl.Rechts
jobs.description:
The German Institute of Human Nutrition Potsdam-Rehbruecke (DIfE) (https://www.dife.de/en) is a member of the Leibniz Association. The institute’s mission is to conduct experimental and clinical research in the field of nutrition and health, with the aim of understanding the molecular basis of nutrition-dependent diseases, and of developing new strategies for treatment and prevention.

The Department of Experimental Diabetology (DIAB) (https://www.dife.de/en/research/departments-and-labs/experimental-diabetology/) and the Junior Research Group Epigenetics of Obesity and Diabetes (EOD) (https://www.dife.de/en/research/departments-and-labs/epigenetics-of-obesity-and-diabetes/) invite applications for

1 Postdoc (m/f/d)

starting January 1, 2027.

We are looking for a highly motivated Computational Biologist/Bioinformatician to join our teams, which focus on understanding how obesity and type 2 diabetes reshape the epigenome, with the goal of identifying disease-associated genes and epigenetic alterations. Using lean and obese mouse models and translational validation in humans, we investigate how interventions such as intermittent fasting, endurance training, and bariatric surgery can modulate disease-induced molecular changes.

Tasks

- Perform end-to-end data analysis, including quality control, data integration and inference of regulatory networks
- Analyze and interpret multiome datasets (e. g. transcriptomics, epigenomics and related modalities)
- Apply advanced computational and statistical methods for integrative analysis of multi-layer biological data
- Develop clear data visualizations, reports and written summaries to communicate results
- Collaborate closely with laboratory scientists to translate biological questions into computational analyses

Skills and requirements

- Excellent master and doctoral degree in Computational Science/Bioinformatics
- Strong background in biological fundamentals, including genetics and epigenetics
- Experience with multiome data analysis (e. g. Lipidomics, Proteomics, ATAC-seq)
- Expertise in programming languages such as R or Python
- Proven experience with advanced computational methods for data integration and interpretation
- Strong communication skills and ability to work in interdisciplinary teams
- Fluency in spoken and written English

We offer

- Excellent technical equipment, a wide range of experimental methods and a dynamic and interactive research environment
- Remuneration according to TV-L, level 13, plus annual special payment and company pension scheme
- Family-friendly working conditions (certificate “audit berufundfamilie”)
- Supporting of mobility with a jobticket for using the public transport
- Easy accessibility by public transport or car (including free parking)
- 30 days of vacation
- Participation in the benefits program for employees („Corporate Benefits“)

The position is available for 1 year.

We promote the employment of people with severe disabilities and are committed to equal opportunities for them. Applicants with severe disabilities will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications.

We look forward to your application!

Please send your documents (cover letter explaining your motivation, CV, copies of degrees/certificates and references) with reference number 2026_W12_BA as a single pdf-file before November 8, 2026 via e-mail to jobs@dife.de.

For further information please do not hesitate to contact:

PD Dr. Heike Vogel

Deputy Head of the Department Experimental Diabetology

E-Mail: heikevogel@dife.de

We process your application documents for the purpose of carrying out the application procedure in accordance with Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b) GDPR, Art. 88 GDPR. For more information on the collection, processing and use of personal data by the German Institute of Human Nutrition as part of the application process and your rights under data protection law, please contact the Department of Human Resources and Social Services (jobs@dife.de).

BERNER is transforming its digital commerce landscape across Europe.

- Own and prioritize the backlog for defined areas of the BERNER Commerce Platform

- Align backlog priorities with the product roadmap and overall E-Commerce strategy
- Challenge requirements and promote scalable, reusable and standard solutions

- Enjoy turning complex business needs into clear and actionable product solutions
- Like working between business and IT and creating alignment across different stakeholder groups
- Are comfortable challenging requirements instead of simply implementing requests

- Strong analytical, conceptual and problem-solving skills
- Experience working with agile software-development teams
- Very good stakeholder-management and communication skills
- Independent, structured and self-organized way of working
- Fluent English; good German skills are an advantage

- Experience in B2B E-Commerce
- Experience in international or multi-country product environments
- Understanding of connected commerce systems such as PIM, CMS or ERP
- Experience in wholesale, distribution or professional customer environments

- A key role in the transformation of BERNER’s E-Commerce landscape
- Real Product Owner responsibility from requirement to rollout and continuous improvement
- The opportunity to shape a digital commerce platform used across Europe
- Close collaboration with business, engineering and local markets
- An international environment with visible business impact
- The opportunity to influence how BERNER develops digital products in the future
- Individual training and development opportunities

 WHY BERNER?

- Job bike leasing (JobRad)  
- Commuting allowance  
- Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  
- Company pension scheme  
- Opportunities for further training  
- Technically modern equipped workplace

 Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations.

“We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.” 
With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully.

The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.

jobs.occupation: Ergotherapist (Occupational Therapist) – Germany International Applicants Welcome (Ergotherapeut/in)
jobs.description:
We are looking for motivated and compassionate Ergotherapists (Occupational Therapists) from abroad who are interested in building their professional careers in Germany. This is an excellent opportunity for qualified professionals who are willing to relocate to Germany and work in a modern healthcare environment.

Successful candidates will support patients in improving their independence, mobility, motor skills, cognitive abilities, and quality of life through individualized therapeutic interventions.

International applicants are welcome to apply. Guidance regarding professional recognition, German language learning, visa procedures, and relocation may be provided, depending on the employer's arrangements.

Key Responsibilities

- Assess patients' physical, cognitive, psychological, and functional abilities.
- Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.
- Provide therapeutic interventions to improve daily living skills and independence.
- Support patients recovering from injuries, illnesses, neurological conditions, or developmental challenges.
- Monitor treatment progress and document therapeutic outcomes.
- Collaborate with physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals.
- Educate patients and their families on therapeutic exercises and everyday activities.
- Maintain accurate patient records and comply with German healthcare standards.

Requirements

- Completed qualification or degree in Ergotherapy/Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution.
- Relevant professional experience is an advantage; motivated recent graduates may also be considered.
- Willingness to relocate to Germany.
- Willingness to learn German and achieve the language level required for professional recognition and employment.
- Motivation to complete the professional recognition process in Germany.
- Strong communication skills, empathy, patience, and a patient-focused approach.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Opportunities for International Applicants

Depending on the employer and individual circumstances, support may include:

- Guidance with recognition of foreign professional qualifications.
- Assistance with German language courses.
- Information and support regarding visa and work permit procedures.
- Relocation guidance and help with settling in Germany.
- Assistance with accommodation arrangements, where available.
- Opportunities for long-term professional development.

What We Offer

- Employment opportunities in Germany's healthcare sector.
- A professional and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities to develop clinical skills and gain international work experience.
- Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, location, and employer.
- Potential long-term career opportunities in Germany.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

- An updated CV in English or German.
- Copies of educational certificates and professional qualifications.
- Evidence of relevant work experience, if available.
- German language certificates, if available.
- Information about current country of residence and willingness to relocate.

Take the next step in your career and start your journey as an Ergotherapist in Germany!

International candidates are encouraged to apply. Employment is subject to the applicable professional recognition, language, immigration, and work authorization requirements in Germany.

Important information for applicants from abroad

In Germany, the profession of Ergotherapeut/in is regulated. Before working under the professional title, applicants generally need recognition of their foreign qualification and authorization to use the professional title.

- Qualification recognition: The responsible authority depends on the German federal state where you intend to work.
- German language: Employers and recognition authorities may require German proficiency. B2 is a useful target, although the exact requirements can vary.
- Visa and relocation: Requirements depend on your nationality, qualifications, and circumstances.
- Job opportunities: Hospitals, rehabilitation centres, private therapy practices, care facilities, and paediatric therapy centres may recruit international professionals.

What to Expect
